# ui::CaptionInsets

Header: `winui/ui/WindowShell.hpp`.

The caption space a window with content extended into its title bar still has to leave alone ([WindowStyle::extend_content_into_title_bar](window-style.md)): the OS's caption buttons on one side, and on the other whatever the OS keeps there (nothing on a left-to-right window). DIPs, window-client coordinates. All zero when the content is not extended, so a [TitleBar](../controls/title-bar.md#uititlebar) can bind to it unconditionally. Read through [Window::caption_insets()](window.md#caption_insets).

Example: 
```cpp
// Keep a custom title row clear of the caption buttons.
ui::Border{
    .padding = ui::bind(window.caption_insets(), [](const ui::CaptionInsets& c) {
        return ui::Edges{.left = c.left, .right = c.right}; }),
    .content = ui::Text{.text = "My app"},
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | `float` | `0.0f` | reserved at the left edge, in DIPs |
| `right` | `float` | `0.0f` | reserved at the right edge (the caption buttons), in DIPs |
| `height` | `float` | `0.0f` | the extended caption row's height |
